item.title: Finding Rest in Christ: Why Christian Women Need to Embrace God’s Gift of Rest — Carina Jung
item.description: Discover the importance of rest in Christ for Christian women, how it strengthens your faith, and why letting go of busyness leads to true peace. Tune into our latest podcast for an in-depth discussion on rest and renewal.

item.title: Christians: Restoring the Family Structure for a Stronger Future — Carina Jung
item.description: Discover how Christians can lead the change in valuing God’s original design for family structure. Explore biblical principles that promote stability, identity, and hope for future generations.

item.title: Putting Children First: Defending the Rights of Future Generations — Carina Jung
item.description: Learn how to champion a pro-child agenda by putting children first in decision-making. Discover biblical insights, practical steps, and highlights from my podcast with Them Before Us.

item.title: What Does the Bible Say About Women in Ministry? — Carina Jung
item.description: Explore a biblically based and thoughtful approach to what the Bible says about women in ministry. Discover key scriptures, interpretations, and the role of women in serving God

item.title: Daniel 1 Bible Study: Standing Firm in a Shifting World — Carina Jung
item.description: Explore Daniel 1 with this Bible study guide. Learn how to stand firm in faith, resist cultural compromise, and trust God

item.title: Daniel 2 Bible Study: God Reveals Mysteries & Kingdoms Fall — Carina Jung
item.description: Explore Daniel 2 in this devotional Bible study. Learn how God reveals mysteries, topples kingdoms, and points us to Christ, the unshakable cornerstone.

item.title: Daniel 3 Bible Study: Faith in the Fire and God’s Deliverance — Carina Jung
item.description: Explore Daniel 3 in this powerful Bible study. Learn how faith stands firm under pressure and how God walks with us through the fire and delivers completely.

item.title: Daniel 4 Bible Study: When God Humbles the Proud — Carina Jung
item.description: Study Daniel 4 and learn how God humbles pride, restores through mercy, and calls us to lift our eyes to heaven. A powerful Bible study on repentance.

item.title: Daniel 5 Bible Study: The Writing on the Wall — Carina Jung
item.description: A powerful Bible study on Daniel 5. Learn about God’s judgment, pride, repentance, and what it means when the writing is already on the wall.

item.title: What Happens After We Die? A Christian View of Eternity & Resurrection — Carina Jung
item.description: Discover what the Bible says happens after death. Explore the Christian view of eternity, resurrection, and heaven in this faith-filled episode of the DAUGHTERS podcast.
